name: adapt_role_list_c_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: allowed_roles.txt (a spec file the role check must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old list into roles.c
prompts: Create roles.c with a function `int is_allowed(const char *role)` returning nonzero if role is in the comma-separated list in allowed_roles.txt (currently: admin, editor), else 0. Read the list from the file at call time - do not hardcode it.
allowed_roles.txt has changed. Make sure is_allowed() reflects the CURRENT list in the file.

disruptions.description: allowed_roles.txt rewritten to add a new role

test_setup_files.test_roles.py:
import subprocess
subprocess.run(['gcc', 'roles.c', 'test_roles_main.c', '-o', 'roles_bin'], check=True)
proc = subprocess.run(['./roles_bin'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr!r}'
assert 'PASS' in proc.stdout
print('PASS')
